description: TapBot v2.7.0 Major Evolution — Fleet Telemetry & Live Analytics Dashboard, Encrypted Fleet Backup/Restore (.tapbotbackup), Android Home Screen AppWidget, and v2.7.0 Production Signed Release

userStories.title: Fleet Analytics Data Models & Atomic Rolling Metric Store
userStories.description: As a bot station operator, I want TapBot to track messages received, commands executed, error counts, and uptime per bot so I can monitor node health.
acceptanceCriteria: Add BotMetricSnapshot and FleetAnalyticsSummary data models in core:model
Implement thread-safe RollingBotMetricStore in core:runner persisting metrics to JSON with atomic updates
Support recording messages, commands, error counts, and active uptime timestamps
Unit tests in core:runner verify metric recording, rolling aggregation, and disk persistence
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Telemetry Interceptor & BotInstanceManager Event Hooking
userStories.description: As a developer, I want incoming Telegram updates and bot command executions to automatically feed the RollingBotMetricStore.
acceptanceCriteria: Hook update processing loop in DefaultBotInstanceManager and BotRuntime to notify RollingBotMetricStore on message arrival and command execution
Expose reactive fleetAnalytics: StateFlow<FleetAnalyticsSummary> from BotInstanceManager
Unit tests in core:runner verify telemetry stream updates when bots process updates
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Encrypted Backup Archive Spec & FleetBackupManager
userStories.description: As a user migrating to a new phone, I want to export an encrypted backup of all my configured bots, tokens, and custom workflows into a .tapbotbackup archive.
acceptanceCriteria: Add FleetBackupArchive data model in core:model encapsulating bot configurations, credentials, and custom bot definitions
Implement FleetBackupManager in core:security using PBKDF2 key derivation and AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption/decryption
Support restoring .tapbotbackup archives with password validation and hardware Keystore re-encryption
Reject corrupted or incorrect password archives with explicit errors
Unit tests in core:security verify backup export, restoration, and tampering rejection
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Fleet Backup & Restore UI in Node Settings
userStories.description: As a user, I want visual 1-tap dialogs in Settings to export and import .tapbotbackup archives with password protection.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Fleet Backup & Migration expandable card to SettingsScreen.kt
Implement Create Encrypted Backup dialog with password confirmation and file export via Android Storage Access Framework
Implement Restore Fleet Backup dialog with file picker and password validation
Unit tests in feature:catalog verify backup state handling in CatalogViewModel
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Fleet Analytics HUD & Per-Bot Activity Badges
userStories.description: As a user viewing My Fleet, I want to see 24-hour total messages processed, command rates, and per-bot activity stats.
acceptanceCriteria: Add FleetAnalyticsHudCard to MyBotsScreen.kt displaying 24h message throughput, command rate, and uptime percentage
Add activity badges to BotInstanceCard showing messages processed today and last active timestamp
CatalogViewModel exposes formatted analytics metrics mapped from BotInstanceManager
Unit tests in feature:catalog verify analytics UI state formatting
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: TapBot Quick Fleet Android Home Screen AppWidget
userStories.description: As a user, I want an Android home screen AppWidget showing active bots and battery percentage with 1-tap Start/Stop emergency controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement TapBotFleetAppWidgetProvider in app module with RemoteViews layout
Widget displays live running bot count, battery status, and 1-tap Start All / Stop All action buttons
Declare appwidget-provider XML and broadcast receiver in AndroidManifest.xml
Trigger widget updates from BotForegroundService on bot state transitions
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Verified by TapBotFleetAppWidgetProvider, layout, provider XML, manifest registration, and BotForegroundService broadcast

userStories.title: Production Release Packaging v2.7.0 & Version Manifest Update
userStories.description: As a user and maintainer, I want a signed v2.7.0 APK binary with updated OTA version.json manifest so clients receive the upgrade.
acceptanceCriteria: Bump app versionCode to 270 and versionName to 2.7.0 in app/build.gradle.kts; sync ApkDeliveryService, CommanderBotRuntime, and diagnostics
Assemble signed production APK releases/tapbot-v2.7.0.apk and verify signature via apksigner (scheme v2 verified: true)
Update version.json and website/version.json with v2.7.0 metadata and SHA-256 checksum
Update releases/README.md, website/index.html, website/app.js, and deploy-pages.yml to v2.7.0
All unit tests pass across all 8 modules with 0 failures
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Verified by assembleRelease (8.18 MB signed APK, scheme v2 true), version.json update, website sync, and 100% test pass rate across all 8 modules
